messages:
Deborah: Heads-up: we're rolling out a billing/quota update next week (2026-05-04). This affects hosted customers only. Please read the short summary and the linked migration doc before Monday.

Deborah: TL;DR: (1) new tiered quota buckets with intelligent microburst behavior, (2) revamped invoice CSV with normalized line_items and usage_codes for downstream parsing, (3) legacy promotional credit sunsetting for very old trial grants (pre-2023) with a migration credit. Full migration plan: https://docs.redwood.example/billing/migration-2026-quota-invoice

Cameron: microburst behavior? how do we treat "intelligent" here?

Deborah: Good question. "Intelligent microburst" = short-lived allowance above nominal quota that is permitted for up to N seconds and is visible to callers via headers. It will be recorded and if bursts are sustained we drop to strict checking for that route.

Priya: Will this change affect our SDK retry behavior? Need to avoid double-retries causing more 429s.

Ryan: We'll add two headers so SDKs can make informed choices: X-Quota-State: soft|strict and X-Quota-Remaining: <int>. SDK patch scheduled same day to respect soft-state (backoff back to baseline) and avoid immediate heavy retries.

SupportBot: Support automated message queued to send to customers hitting new threshold buckets. Template: https://internal.redwood/support/templates/billing-quota-2026.txt

Emma: Finance approved the CSV layout. We confirmed fields: invoice_id, line_item_code, usage_code, usage_amount, unit_price_usd, tax_usd, total_usd. This should make analytics much easier for partners.

Deborah: About legacy promo credits: affected accounts will receive a one-time pro-rated credit for remaining balance or an option to convert to a time-limited coupon for 30 days. We'll email impacted customers 10 days prior.

Cameron: any plan to auto-grant credits to customers who lose access and are flagged as active?

Deborah: Yes, active accounts will get the pro-rated credit automatically. Dormant accounts get an email with one-click reclaim. See migration doc for edge cases.

Priya: What about Dedicated/Private deployments?

Deborah: No change to Dedicated/Private quotas or SLAs. Invoice format change will be offered as an opt-in export format for those customers.

Ryan: Ops note: runtime rollout will be behind a feature flag. We'll emit logs when feature flips, and add a monitoring rule to detect unexpected spike in 429s. Runbook will be in #eng-runtime.

Ops: UI changes to show configurable grace windows (default 72h, max 7d). We'll push the billing portal toggle behind the feature flag and add an admin view for finance. Screencast and changelog entry to follow.

SupportBot: New support tag created: billing-migration-2026. Use on tickets related to CSV parsing or unexpected 429s.

Deborah: Action items: Eng (Ryan) flip feature flag Mon AM. SDK (Priya) release patch to respect new headers. Support prep canned responses (Support). Finance (Emma) validate sample CSVs. Product (Deborah) finalize email cadence. Ops publish changelog + screencast.

Cameron: Please ping #customer-success when the email batch starts so we can triage.

Deborah: Will do. If you see anything odd after rollout, drop root cause samples in this thread. :wave:
